The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
 The picture holds exactly three rows of sprites, top, middle and bottom, with four sprites in each row, twelve sprites in all. The middle and bottom rows: one single long violet crystal segment per cell, upright in the middle row and lying on its side in the bottom row. Never draw the whole boss. Plain flat green everywhere around the sprites, no outlines of cells.

- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- 6 (6) equal square cells laid out as ONE complete grid — TWO rows of THREE (3-column by 2-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.

Cells 3-6 share one pod silhouette at one scale — only the glow state changes.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 880×624 px. Produce EXACTLY 6 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Cells are 224×224 with 48 px flat #51e018 gutters and a 64 px flat key border; every subject centred in its cell with at least 40 px of key around it.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no motion blur.
